Name: Em's Wild Critters
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Is that something rustling between the leaves, or hiding behind a branch?
Make each critter that roams the town a little more sweet
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Exp﻿anded[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/tR8NNQ9Y/Config-Options.png[/img]

Birds: town birds (6), crow, dove, owl
Rodents: rabbits (white and grey), squirrel, opossum
Beach: seagull and crab
Frogs: green and yellow
Butterflies (22)
Parrots (5)

Bear: secret woods bear
Camel: desert trader camel (3 map recolour options)
Intro birds: heron, pelican stork
Travelling cart pig (regular, winter festival, night market)
Ginger Island: gorilla, ﻿kinkajou, lava monkeys

﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip Em's Small and/or Big Critters
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

Each critter is enabled by default. To disable an Em's critter:
Open ﻿the [i]config.json[/i] file in the mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]true[/color]" with "[color=#e69138]false[/color]"
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]
